body_html:
AI automation for the Village of Tequesta

Small businesses in Tequesta run lean — often it's the owner doing the work, answering the phone, and chasing the invoice all at once. That's exactly where things slip: a lead emails at 7pm, nobody sees it until tomorrow, and the job's gone. Automation gives a one- or two-person operation the responsiveness of a much bigger company.

We build systems that catch every lead and handle the busywork so you can stay on the actual work.

What we automate

  • Instant lead follow-up — every inquiry gets an immediate reply, even after hours.
  • Booking & scheduling — clients self-book without the back-and-forth.
  • Review generation — automatic review requests to build the local reputation that matters in a tight-knit market.
  • Repetitive ops — reminders, quotes, and follow-ups that run on their own.

How it works with your business

We find where leads and hours leak, wire automations into the tools you already use, and keep you in control. You get back the time a small team can't spare.

Serving Tequesta and the north county

We work with businesses across Tequesta, Jupiter, Juno Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, and North Palm Beach — and extend through Palm Beach County as you grow.

faq.q: I'm a one-person business in Tequesta — is automation overkill?
faq.a: It's the opposite — solo and small operations benefit most, because automation covers the follow-up and scheduling you physically can't get to while you're working.
No — it removes repetitive work like chasing leads and asking for reviews so your time goes to the jobs that need you.

faq.q: Does it work with the tools I already use?
faq.a: Usually yes — we connect automations to your existing CRM, calendar, and phone instead of replacing them.
